description: The chart, graph (pie/bar/line) and big-number widgets on a report: Name, Type, TypeDesc, Size and Hash (the hash embeds the widget). Text and datagrid widgets are not returned. Wufoo: GET /reports/{identifier}/widgets.json.

report.description: Report identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. qa4d98l1ib9or7) or its URL title. See wufoo_list_reports.

name: wufoo_list_report_widgets
title: List report widgets
